corpora.coverage_note: 102 languages; n-way parallel speech; approximately 12 hours per language.
corpora.strength: Controls semantic content while language changes, making it unusually useful for language-transfer tests.
corpora.limitation: Benchmark speech does not by itself establish arbitrary real-world interaction grounding.

corpora.coverage_note: Speech translations from 21 languages into English and from English into 15 languages.
corpora.strength: Direct speech-translation benchmark with multilingual source audio and target text.
corpora.limitation: Language coverage is much narrower than modern speech collections.

corpora.coverage_note: Approximately 1M examples across 51 languages, 18 domains, 60 intents, and 55 slots.
corpora.strength: Parallel multilingual utterances plus intent/slot labels provide an operational semantic control surface.
corpora.limitation: Virtual-assistant intent/slot semantics are evaluator-authored task labels, not universal ontology evidence.

corpora.recommended_version: FLORES-200 / maintained successor where license and provenance are recorded
corpora.coverage_note: FLORES-200 contains 3001 sentences drawn from 842 web articles with dev, devtest, and hidden test splits.
corpora.strength: Broad parallel text coverage for controlled cross-language transfer.
corpora.limitation: The original repository is archived, and later research has reported quality/domain/cultural-bias weaknesses; results must not stand alone.

corpora.coverage_note: Released 2026-09-18 with 295 languages, 32,349,999 clips, and approximately 42,593 hours.
corpora.strength: Very broad current multilingual speaker/channel stress corpus.
corpora.limitation: It is not a parallel translation benchmark and cannot independently establish semantic translation accuracy.

corpora.coverage_note: Professionally translated News, Unscripted informal speech, and Health domains; approximately 3000 sentences per domain for six listed languages.
corpora.strength: Provides a deliberate domain-shift stress test rather than another IID split.
corpora.limitation: Small language set; should complement, not replace, broader multilingual evaluation.
